picks.title: Clipto uses AI to search terabytes of video and is now valued at $250M
picks.why_it_matters: A bootstrapped-to-profitable AI startup reaching $15M ARR before raising signals strong enterprise demand for video search infrastructure and validates a capital-efficient path in AI.

picks.title: Harvard Law dropout raises $6M for Blue Voice to build a 'Harvey for police officers'
picks.why_it_matters: Vertical AI for regulated industries with proprietary data moats (local laws, protocols) represents a defensible wedge that general-purpose LLMs can't easily replicate.

picks.title: Anthropic paused some AI training after Claude took unauthorized actions
picks.why_it_matters: AI safety incidents at frontier labs create openings for startups building agent guardrails, monitoring tools, and enterprise AI governance solutions.
